meta.project: Wisender Pro - WhatsApp Business API Platform

product_overview: Wisender Pro is a WhatsApp Business API platform that helps businesses manage messaging, automation, and customer conversations at scale. It provides session management, team inbox tooling, chatbot flows, and secure authentication for operational use.
core_goals: Enable businesses to send and receive WhatsApp messages reliably at scale
Provide session management for WhatsApp device connectivity and persistence
Support multi-agent team inbox workflows for coordinated customer communication
Allow creation and management of automated chatbot flows
Secure the platform with JWT authentication and role-based access control

features.name: Authentication
features.description: Users can register and log in to access protected platform features using JWT-based authentication.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/register with valid user details -> Receive 201 with new user account -> POST /api/auth/login with registered credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token
POST /api/auth/login with invalid credentials -> Receive 401 unauthorized error

features.name: Session Management
features.description: Users can create and view WhatsApp device sessions for connecting and maintaining WhatsApp account state.
user_flows: POST /api/sessions/create with valid authenticated request -> Receive 201 with new session created -> GET /api/sessions with auth token -> Receive 200 with session list
POST /api/sessions/create without valid authentication -> Receive 401 unauthorized error

features.name: WhatsApp Messaging
features.description: Authenticated users can send WhatsApp messages through the platform and receive inbound webhook events.
user_flows: POST /api/whatsapp/send with valid auth token and message payload -> Receive 200 confirming message send request accepted -> POST /api/whatsapp/webhook from WhatsApp event source -> Receive 200 acknowledging incoming webhook
POST /api/whatsapp/send with missing or invalid auth token -> Receive 401 unauthorized error

features.name: Team Inbox
features.description: Users can view shared conversations in a multi-agent inbox to coordinate customer interactions.
user_flows: GET /api/inbox/conversations with valid auth token -> Receive 200 with conversation list
GET /api/inbox/conversations without auth token -> Receive 401 unauthorized error

features.name: Chatbot Automation
features.description: Authorized users can create automated chatbot flows for responding to customer messages and orchestrating conversation logic.
user_flows: POST /api/chatbot/flows with valid auth token and flow definition -> Receive 201 with created chatbot flow
POST /api/chatbot/flows with malformed flow definition -> Receive 400 validation error
